purpose: One original animated mine identity per rare resource, using neutral Stonework Guilds materials and true source alpha; detached machinery registered by packing tool.

prompts.prompt: Create an original production sprite sheet for a high-detail hand-painted fantasy strategy adventure-map building, in the Stonework Guilds visual family: weathered neutral grey limestone masonry, dark iron, restrained aged bronze and timber, crisp readable forms like painted miniature architecture. Elevated three-quarter orthographic view, front and right side visible, light from upper-left, no perspective distortion. Biome-neutral building with no grass, snow, water, sand, scenic platform, floor tile, cast shadow, or terrain mat. True transparent alpha background, no painted backdrop or checkerboard. Output 1536x1024 landscape. One large complete STATIONARY building occupies only x=30..1030, y=35..970, fully inside frame. Clear south/front-centre entrance. Broad three-tile-wide two-tile-deep foundation, building about as wide as tall, substantial but not a tower/castle. Main building left must be fully painted behind absent machinery, no alpha holes in walls. Keep chimney outlet, amber lantern glass and axle mounts clearly visible. NO smoke or glow halos painted into the image: those are runtime effects. NO ownership flags, text, labels, logos, borders or people. RIGHT COLUMN x=1130..1500 contains TWO detached machinery parts in separate transparent slots, upper part around (1310,260), lower part around (1310,755). No paint crossing the empty gutter x=1040..1110. Detached parts MUST NOT also appear installed in the main building. Parts must use the same camera and palette; maximum 280x340 pixels each, no stands or extra backgrounds. AETHERGLASS CUTTING MINE: broad limestone crystal-cutting workshop with a low faceted blue-glass roof lantern, slate roof wings, blue translucent prism piles tightly against its base, a front cutting alcove and modest timber hoist on right. Only small material-specific blue accents. Stone chimney rear-left, two amber lanterns beside doorway. Left/front side cutting alcove has a clear exposed axle on a fully painted dark backing: the polishing wheel is absent. Right hoist retains arm and support but bucket and all hanging rope are absent. DETACHED UPPER: one large oblique circular aged-bronze polishing flywheel with 6 open spokes and dark rim, no axle extension. DETACHED LOWER: a small iron lifting cradle carrying two azure crystal prisms, no chain or rope.
